title: Brew group jam / mechanical fault
shortDescription: The brew group did not return to home position.
fullDescription:
Error 01 on Saeco machines indicates the brew group cannot find its home position. Causes include a jammed group, a worn drive gear, or a failed home position microswitch.

On Xelsis and PicoBaristo the brew group is removable - cleaning usually clears the fault.

If cleaning and lubrication do not help, the gearbox or motor likely needs replacement.

fixSteps.title: Remove brew group
fixSteps.instruction: Open service door, remove brew group.

title: Grinder jam
shortDescription: The grinder motor stalled or stones are jamming the burrs.
fullDescription: Error 02 indicates the grinder cannot turn freely. A coffee bean fragment, stone, or worn burr is the typical cause.

fixSteps.title: Inspect burrs
fixSteps.instruction: Set grinder to coarsest, run, then fine.

faq.a: Adjust grind only when grinder is running with beans.

title: Hydraulic circuit blocked
shortDescription: Pressure too high - water cannot flow through brew path.
fullDescription: Error 03 is triggered when the pressure sensor reports excessive pressure or no flow. Limescale, fine grinds, or a clogged shower screen cause it.

faq.a: Use the bypass chute and medium grind.

title: Heating timeout
shortDescription: Boiler did not reach temperature in allowed time.
fullDescription: Error 04 means the heating element is on but temperature rise is too slow. Limescale or a tripped thermal fuse are typical.

title: Brew group communication error
shortDescription: Brew group encoder or position sensor not responding.
fullDescription: Error 05 indicates the position encoder on the brew group is not reporting valid signals. The unit is detected but cannot be commanded.

title: Empty water circuit / air lock
shortDescription: No water flow detected during priming.
fullDescription: Error 08 indicates an air lock in the pump or empty hydraulic circuit, often after running tank dry.

fixSteps.title: Prime
fixSteps.instruction: Dispense hot water until steady stream.

title: Steam temperature sensor fault
fullDescription: Error 11 occurs on dual boiler models when the steam boiler NTC reads outside range.

faq.a: Coffee may still brew but milk drinks fail.

title: Steam boiler overheat
fullDescription: Error 14 trips when the steam boiler temperature is too high, likely caused by a stuck triac or low water level.

title: EEPROM error
fullDescription: Error 19 indicates the control board cannot read or write its EEPROM. Often after power surges.

title: Descaling cycle required
fullDescription: Saeco tracks descaling intervals based on water hardness setting and shots brewed. The Calc Clean light or message persists until descale is complete.

fixSteps.title: Start descaling
fixSteps.instruction: Add Saeco descaler and follow menu.

title: Set water hardness
shortDescription: First-use prompt to configure water hardness.
fullDescription: Saeco asks for hardness on first setup using the included strip. This determines descaling intervals and filter life.

fixSteps.title: Test water
fixSteps.instruction: Dip strip in water, read result, enter via menu.

faq.a: Adjust based on your local water.

title: Puck container full
fullDescription: After 12-15 cycles Saeco prompts puck container emptying. Reset by removing while machine is on.

fixSteps.title: Empty container
fixSteps.instruction: Remove with machine on, empty, reinsert.

title: Error 06 Brew Unit Stuck
shortDescription: Brew unit cannot reach home position.
fullDescription: Saeco/Philips error 06 means the brew unit motor cannot complete its cycle, usually due to coffee debris or a worn return spring.

fixSteps.title: Remove brew unit
fixSteps.instruction: On removable-unit models, take out and rinse under warm water.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Apply Saeco lube to brew unit posts.

videoSearchQuery: Saeco error 06 brew unit clean fix

faq.a: Most Saeco models yes — different from Jura.

title: Error 07 Empty Drip Tray
shortDescription: Drip tray full alert with sensor fault detection.
fullDescription: Error 07 indicates drip tray water level high, usually after intensive use without emptying.

title: Milk Frother Failure
shortDescription: Internal milk carafe or frother not producing foam.
fullDescription: Saeco Xelsis and GranBaristo milk system needs daily rinse; clogs cause frother failure.

fixSteps.title: Disassemble carafe
fixSteps.instruction: Wash all parts in warm soapy water.

videoSearchQuery: Saeco milk frother no foam fix

title: Grinder No Output
shortDescription: Grinder spins but no coffee dispenses to brew unit.
fullDescription: Saeco grinder may run without dispensing if beans are bridged, the chute is clogged, or grind is set too coarse to produce volume.

causes.cause: Coffee chute clogged with old grounds

fixSteps.title: Vacuum chute
fixSteps.instruction: Remove brew unit, vacuum the coffee chute.

videoSearchQuery: Saeco grinder no grind output fix

title: AquaClean Filter Replace
shortDescription: AquaClean filter has reached end of life.
fullDescription: Saeco AquaClean filter eliminates descaling for up to 8 cycles. After 8 changes, descaling is required.
symptoms: May ask for descale instead after 8x

faq.a: No — after 8 filter changes, descaling is required.

title: Beans Empty
fullDescription: Sensor in bean hopper detects beans below threshold and prevents grinding to avoid burr damage.

fixSteps.title: Tap to break bridge
fixSteps.instruction: If beans visible but alert remains, tap hopper.

faq.a: Avoid very oily — they clog burrs and chute.

title: Steam Wand Will Not Steam
shortDescription: Manual steam wand on PicoBaristo does not produce steam.
fullDescription: Steam wand requires steam mode active. Wand tip clogs are common.
videoSearchQuery: Saeco steam wand no steam fix

faq.a: Yes manually with cold milk and proper technique.

title: Descale Cycle Required
fullDescription: After AquaClean filter changes are exhausted, machine requires full descaling with Saeco solution.

fixSteps.title: Enter descale menu
fixSteps.instruction: Hold setup until descale option appears.

fixSteps.title: Pour solution
fixSteps.instruction: Mix Saeco descaler with water in tank.

videoSearchQuery: Saeco descale procedure step by step

title: Insert Brew Unit
shortDescription: Brew unit not detected — likely removed for cleaning and not reinserted.
fullDescription: Most Saeco models have a removable brew unit. After cleaning, it must be reinserted in the home position.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Align arrows on brew unit, push until click.

videoSearchQuery: Saeco insert brew unit how to reinstall

faq.a: Press button on side, align arrows, push until click.

title: Connect Milk Carafe
shortDescription: Milk carafe not detected on Xelsis or LatteGo systems.
fullDescription: Carafe must connect to spout. Misalignment or worn rubber seal causes detection failure.

causes.cause: Carafe not slid all the way in
